ops.text: yasyf/cc-skills long-running-ci.yml triggers pull_request only for branches: [main], so a PR stacked on another open PR (base is that PR's branch) runs only the Socket checks. pr-poll then reports ready-to-merge with no lr-go or pytest at all. Seen on #3456 stacked on #3439, 2026-11-06. Fix: drop the branches filter on pull_request, or have pr-poll refuse ready-to-merge when a required workflow never triggered.
